theater: 倫巴第阿涅德洛與威尼斯潟湖

battle.name: 康布雷同盟戰爭
battle.theater: 倫巴第阿涅德洛與威尼斯潟湖
battle.brief: 一五〇八年十二月，教宗朱利奧二世在康布雷糾集神聖羅馬帝國、法蘭西與阿拉貢王國組成討伐威尼斯的同盟。一五〇九年四月二十三日阿涅德洛一戰，威尼斯陸軍遭衝擊而潰敗，火砲與輜重盡失，同盟軍乘勢奪取帕多瓦。教宗一五一〇年排斥法國，威尼斯得奧斯曼援助，戰事拖長。輪發手槍只配軍官與近衛。

kit.name: 輪發槍
kit.history: 最早的後膛手槍。機械太貴，只給火槍隊的軍官與衛兵。

countries:
這場戰爭的交戰方可以分成兩大集團，但兩邊都不是統一國家，必須分層看。
同盟方：核心是教宗國。教宗朱利奧二世以教宗權威號召四方，並且自己出錢僱傭兵；他的主要客戶是費拉拉公國（阿方索一世·德斯特）與佛羅倫斯、錫耶納、盧卡三個共和國，這些邦國提供了意大利本土的步兵與大部分現金。神聖羅馬帝國方面，皇帝馬西米利安一世自帶德意志傭兵（蘭斯克內希特）與帝國諸邦的援軍，另有來自波希米亞、匈牙利與德意志西南部的僱傭單位。法蘭西王國的路易十二出動約一萬人，目標是米蘭，與教宗、皇帝的目的並不一致，結果在瓜分米蘭時立即翻臉。西班牙阿拉貢王國以費爾南多二世的名義參與，由「偉大隊長」貢薩洛·費爾南德斯·德·科爾多瓦率領長槍與弩兵隊，他的孫子卡洛斯日後繼承了這份未了結的義大利戰爭。馬耳他騎士團也站在聯盟一邊。
威尼斯一方：威尼斯共和國本身是對面唯一還保有完整組織能力的國家，陸軍由元老院議員安德烈亞·文德拉明統兵、巴托洛梅奧·阿爾維亞諾實際指揮，另有米蘭公國（斯福爾扎家族復辟）與薩伏依公國站在同一邊。威尼斯的真正後盾是奧斯曼帝國：巴耶齊德二世於一五〇八年九月與威尼斯訂立密約，許諾以金錢與兵船相助；德意志與匈牙利的傭兵則填補了威尼斯本身的兵源缺口。
countriesEn:
The two camps in this war are best understood as layers rather than as unified states.
The League side was built around the Papal States. Pope Julius II summoned the powers together in the name of papal authority and, crucially, supplied the silver that paid for the mercenaries. His main clients were the Duchy of Ferrara under Alfonso I d'Este and the republics of Florence, Siena and Lucca, which supplied both Italian foot soldiers and much of the ready cash. The Holy Roman Empire came with Emperor Maximilian I, his German landsknechts and contingents from the imperial estates, joined by companies from Bohemia, Hungary and south-western Germany. The Kingdom of France under Louis XII fielded about ten thousand men, but its object was Milan and it did not match that of the pope or the emperor, and the two fell out the moment the spoils of Milan came to be divided. The Crown of Aragon joined in the name of Ferdinand II, with long pike and crossbow troops led by the Great Captain, Gonzalo Fernandez de Cordoba; his grandson Charles was later to inherit this unfinished Italian war. The Knights of St John also sat on the League side.
Venice's side: the Republic of Venice was the only state over there with real organisation left in it, its land army commanded in the field by the senator Andrea Vendramin with Bartolomeo d'Alviano exercising the tactical command, while the Duchy of Milan under the restored Sforza and the Duchy of Savoy stood with it. Venice's real support came from the Ottoman Empire: in September 1508 Bayezid II concluded a secret agreement with the Republic, promising money and shipping, and German and Hungarian mercenaries filled out the gaps in the Venetian ranks.
people:
教宗朱利奧二世是整場戰爭的設計者。他要拿回羅馬尼亞、削弱威尼斯在亞得里亞海的商業壟斷，同時不肯讓米蘭落入法國手中；這位「戰士教宗」在樞機院、教廷財政與各邦的效忠之間左右全局。
皇帝馬西米利安一世自帶軍隊作戰，卻被經費拖住：僱傭兵欠餉，士卒在特倫托與阿迪杰河谷因疫病與缺糧散去。他同時是當時歐洲最熱心的火器收藏者之一，私人軍械庫所藏的輪發式火器，正是卡面那件兵器在這個年代的實際流傳管道，也說明它在同盟軍中只掌握在少數人手中。
法王路易十二為米蘭而來，目標與教宗不同，故在一五一〇年被逐出同盟。戰場上法軍的實際指揮是耶夫二世·達列格雷，前鋒交給雅克·德·拉·帕利斯，法國騎兵的衝鋒則由「私生子」波旁公爵查理三世率領——正是這一次衝鋒把阿涅德洛的會戰翻了盤。
威尼斯方面，安德烈亞·文德拉明在阿涅德洛受傷被俘，兵權落到巴托洛梅奧·阿爾維亞諾手中；總督彼得羅·蘭多與元老院主導外交、談判與徵兵。聯軍一側，德意志傭兵隊長格奧爾格·馮·弗爾斯滕貝格是老兵中的老兵，屢次在最壞的時候穩住陣腳。一五一二年的拉文納之役，法軍指揮是加斯東·德·福瓦，戰死於拉文納；一五〇八年之後接任教宗的良十世另組「神聖同盟」，把戰爭目標從對付威尼斯改成驅逐法國；一五一七年一線，教皇與皇帝的聯軍則由烏爾比諾公爵弗朗切斯科·馬里亞·德拉·羅韋雷指揮。
peopleEn: Pope Julius II designed the whole war. He wanted the Romagna back, wanted to break Venice's commercial monopoly of the Adriatic, and was unwilling to let Milan fall into French hands; this warrior pope steered the outcome through the College of Cardinals, the papal finances and the loyalties of the various states. Emperor Maximilian I campaigned with his own army, yet was held back by money: mercenaries went unpaid and his men dissolved in the Adige valley and at Trent through lack of provisions and sickness. At the same time he was among the most enthusiastic firearm collectors in Europe of his day, and the wheel-lock pieces in his private armoury are exactly the channel through which the weapon on this card was circulating, and exactly why it remained in so few hands inside the League army. King Louis XII came for Milan; his aim did not match the pope's, and he was driven out of the League in 1510. In the field the French were led by Yves II d'Algre, the vanguard by Jacques de la Palice, and the French cavalry charge was led by Charles III of Bourbon, the bastard of Bourbon, and it was that charge which turned the battle of Agnadello. On the Venetian side Andrea Vendramin was wounded and taken prisoner at Agnadello, and command passed to Bartolomeo d'Alviano, while the doge Pietro Lando and the Senate directed diplomacy, negotiation and recruitment. On the League side the landsknecht captain Georg von Frundsberg was the hard core of the old soldiers, steadying the line again and again at the worst moments. In the battle of Ravenna in 1512 the French were commanded by Gaston de Foix, who fell there; the pope who succeeded Julius II, Leo X, formed the Holy League and turned the object of the war from Venice to the expulsion of the French; and in 1517 the papal-imperial army was led by Francesco Maria della Rovere, Duke of Urbino.
kits:
這場戰爭的裝備骨架仍然是長矛、火繩步槍、弩與重砲。火繩步槍仍靠火繩點燃，雨天、夜戰與行軍中都受限制。威尼斯步兵以弩手（弓弩手）與「schioppi」（火繩手槍）混編見長，另配一支精銳長矛兵；德意志蘭斯克內希特以長矛方陣為主，只配置少量火槍手；西班牙部隊此時仍用「楔形陣」（cuna），以長槍與弩手混編，尚未定型為後來的方陣。攻城靠重砲與壕溝掘進，圍帕多瓦時聯軍運來的大砲與攻城塔都未能攻破城牆。
卡面這件輪發手槍在此役的位置相當窄而典型。輪發機構約在一五〇〇年前後於低地國家出現，靠上弦發條帶動鋼輪擊打火石，毋須火繩，但上弦要轉動多圈，機件怕潮、耗藥多、造價遠高於火繩手槍。一五〇九年的阿涅德洛之戰，決定勝負的是聯軍野戰砲兵的大口徑砲彈與法軍騎兵的衝鋒，輪發手槍在這種縱隊亂戰中只能當軍官的隨身自衛武器，談不上火力骨幹。實際持有者大致三種人：各級軍官與旗手、君王的近衛侍從（皇帝、國王、侯爵的衛隊多配手槍）、以及下馬步戰的騎兵指揮官。騎兵近身時仍靠刀與短柄武器，輪發手槍的好處是不必舉著火繩、可以一邊上弦一邊射擊，缺點是射速慢、一次故障就成累贅。
其餘裝備與後勤：騎兵分重騎（胸甲、長柄騎槍、刺馬槍）與輕騎（手槍、輕盔）；運輸靠牛車、騾車隊與可拆式浮橋，渡波河與阿迪杰河全靠舟橋與淺灘強渡；黑火藥的消耗以噸計，供應倚賴西西里與那不勒斯的硫磺來源以及木炭，隊商道路、徵用船隻與渡口正是決定戰役節奏的東西。
kitsEn: The equipment skeleton of this war was still the pike, the matchlock musket, the crossbow and the heavy cannon. Matchlocks were still lit by a burning cord, which handicapped them in rain, at night and on the march. Venetian infantry were famous for mixing crossbowmen with shooters armed with the schioppi, the matchlock arquebuses, and they added a body of picked pikemen; the German landsknechts fought in pike blocks with only a few gunners attached; the Spanish troops at this date still used the wedge formation, the cuna, mixing long pikes with crossbowmen and not yet settled into the tercios of the following decades. Siege work was done with heavy guns and by sapping, and the great cannon and siege towers the League brought against Padua did not break the walls. The position of the wheellock pistol on this card is characteristically narrow. The wheel-lock mechanism appeared in the Low Countries around 1500, driving a steel wheel from a wound spring to strike against pyrite so that no match was needed, but it took many turns of the crank to cock, the mechanism suffered from damp, it burned a lot of powder and it cost far more than a matchlock gun. In the fighting at Agnadello in 1509 the outcome was settled by the League's field artillery and the French cavalry charge, and a wheellock pistol could only ever be an officer's personal weapon in a disorderly column battle; it was never the backbone of any firing line. There were broadly three sorts of holder: officers and ensigns of every rank, the bodyguards of princes, kings and dukes, who were commonly armed with pistols, and mounted officers who fought on foot. In the close fighting of cavalry the sword and short weapons still did the work, and the wheellock's advantage was that it needed no lit match and could be cocked and fired at the same time, while its drawback was its slow rate of fire, since a single malfunction turned it into a dead weight. The rest of the equipment and the logistics: the cavalry divided into heavy horse in cuirasses with long lances and couched coubards, and light horse with pistols and light helmets; transport ran on ox carts, mule trains and demountable pontoon bridges, and the crossings of the Po and the Adige were made by boat bridge and by fording the shallows; black powder was consumed by the ton, drawn from the sulphur of Sicily and Naples together with charcoal, and the wagon roads, the requisitioned shipping and the fords were precisely what set the rhythm of the campaign.
tactics:
一五〇九年的作戰，聯盟採兩路鉗形：帝國軍自蒂羅爾沿阿迪杰河谷南下，經特倫托、里瓦與維羅納，穿越威尼納加爾山脈後在波河下游與法軍會合；法軍取穿越阿爾卑斯山的松薩小徑，經皮埃蒙特南下，兩軍在克雷馬東南的阿涅德洛會師。四月二十三日交戰時，聯軍以重砲兵團先行展開，用砲火壓制威尼斯軍陣；威尼斯縱隊仍在行進中未及展開，砲兵與輜重留在營地，法軍騎兵在帝國騎兵掩護下衝擊威尼斯縱隊尾部與兩翼，先以數千騎犁開陣形，再由步兵與傭兵壓上，威尼斯軍全軍潰散，營帳、火砲與全部輜重落入聯軍之手。聯軍損失以百計，威尼斯方面陣亡約五千、被俘約一千五百至二千。
聯軍隨後圍困帕多瓦，圍城數月不成：七月維內斯援軍在皮亞韋河一線打退解圍攻勢，城內守軍與民兵頂住了猛攻，同年十二月聯軍因缺糧、疫病與季節因素撤圍，帕多瓦守住了。聯盟另一手是海上封鎖，帝國與聯盟的艦隊進入威尼斯潟湖、切斷城市的海上通道；但封鎖艦隊在潟湖內屢遭風暴與威尼斯槳船的襲擾而損折，聯盟既無力封海也無力攻城，戰局遂僵。聯盟內部又因分贓不均生裂痕：一五一〇年教宗把法國逐出同盟，另組涵蓋皇帝、西班牙與佛羅倫薩的「神聖同盟」，目標改為收復博洛尼亞、驅逐法國。一五一二年初法軍乘勝攻入拉文納，擊潰教皇與西班牙聯軍，加斯東·德·福瓦陣亡；然而六月僱傭的瑞士傭兵因欠餉拒不進攻，聯軍反攻在即，法軍反而被迫退出羅馬尼亞，攻守易勢。
tacticsEn: The campaign of 1509 was fought as a pincer. The imperial army came down the Adige valley from the Tyrol, through Trent, Riva and Verona, crossed the mountains of the Venetian hinterland and joined the French downstream on the Po, while the French took the Susa path over the Alps and came down through Piedmont, the two armies meeting at Agnadello south-east of Crema. When the battle was fought on 23 April the League had already deployed its heavy artillery park and was battering the Venetian position with shot; the Venetian column was still on the march and had not finished deploying, its guns and baggage were still in the camp, and the French cavalry, screened by the imperial horse, struck the tail and both wings of the Venetian column, ploughing through the formation with several thousand riders before the foot and the mercenaries pressed home. The Venetian army broke, and the tents, the cannon and all the baggage fell into League hands. The League's losses were in the hundreds; on the Venetian side about five thousand were killed and something between one thousand five hundred and two thousand were taken prisoner. The League then invested Padua and could not take it in several months: in July a Venetian relief force turned back the relieving movements of the besiegers on the Piave, the garrison and the militia of the city held off the assaults, and in December the League withdrew because of lack of provisions, sickness and the season, leaving Padua in place. The League's other arm was the blockade at sea, where an imperial and League fleet entered the Venetian lagoon and cut the city's sea approaches; but the blockading fleet was battered in the lagoon by storms and by Venetian galleys and lost enough of its strength to make the blockade ineffective, and with neither a working blockade nor a working siege the war stalled. The League then cracked over the division of the spoils: in 1510 the pope expelled France and formed the Holy League, embracing the emperor, Spain and Florence, and the object became the recovery of Bologna and the expulsion of the French. Early in 1512 the French carried the war into Ravenna, beat the papal and Spanish army and lost Gaston de Foix, who was killed; but in June the hired Swiss mercenaries refused to advance because their pay was in arrears, and with the League counter-attacking the French were forced out of the Romagna instead, so that attacker and defender changed places.
data:
可核對的數字集中在四個節點。同盟於一五〇八年十二月十日在康布雷宣布成立，一五〇九年四月進入戰役。
阿涅德洛之戰（一五〇九年四月二十三日）：聯軍總兵力約二萬至三萬，其中帝國方面約一萬八千至二萬二千（含德意志蘭斯克內希特約八千至一萬），法軍約一萬；威尼斯軍約一萬四千至一萬六千，其中騎兵約四千至五千。威尼斯的損失是陣亡約五千、被俘約一千五百至二千，全軍火砲與輜重被奪，聯軍損失僅數百人。
圍帕多瓦（一五〇九年七月至十二月）：圍城軍在編制上被記為三萬人上下，實際在城下的兵力遠少於此，十二月撤圍。海上的封鎖延續數月，聯盟艦隊在潟湖受損後失去封鎖能力。
拉文納（一五一二年二月二十三日）：法軍約二萬五千至三萬人，教皇與西班牙聯軍約一萬二千，另有瑞士傭兵約六千；法軍獲勝但加斯東·德·福瓦陣亡，六月初瑞士傭兵拒絕作戰，聯軍得以反攻。
外交與財政的數字同樣重要：一五一三年十一月法國與聯盟在奧爾維耶托議和，一五一六年在努瓦松再訂條約，一五一七年九月六日特雷比亞（洛迪）之戰威尼斯軍獲勝，一五一八年康布雷休戰五年，戰爭至此收束。聯盟靠教廷的德意志銀礦收入與奧格斯堡的福格、韋爾瑟兩家銀行的貸款運作，馬西米利安的軍隊因此長期欠餉，僱傭兵一五〇九年前後已兩度兵變。
dataEn: The verifiable figures cluster around four moments. The League was proclaimed at Cambrai on 10 December 1508, and the fighting opened in April 1509. At the battle of Agnadello on 23 April 1509 the League fielded between twenty and thirty thousand men in all, of whom about eighteen to twenty-two thousand were on the imperial side, including some eight to ten thousand German landsknechts, and about ten thousand were French; the Venetian army numbered roughly fourteen to sixteen thousand with four to five thousand of them horse. The Venetian loss was about five thousand dead and between one thousand five hundred and two thousand prisoners, the whole of their cannon and baggage being taken, while the League lost only a few hundred men. In the siege of Padua, from July to December 1509, the besieging army is given in the order of battle as around thirty thousand, though the number actually present before the walls was far smaller, and the siege was lifted in December. The blockade at sea ran for months, and once the League fleet had been damaged in the lagoon it lost the ability to blockade. At Ravenna on 23 February 1512 the French had about twenty-five to thirty thousand against some twelve thousand for the papal and Spanish army, with about six thousand Swiss mercenaries besides; the French won, but Gaston de Foix was killed, and when the Swiss refused to fight in early June the League was able to counter-attack. The diplomatic and financial figures matter just as much: in November 1513 France and the League made peace at Orvieto, a further treaty was concluded at Noyon in 1516, the Venetians won the battle of the Trebbia, at Lodi, on 6 September 1517, and the truce of Cambrai of 1518 brought five years of peace and closed the war. The League ran on the papacy's income from the German silver mines and on loans from the Fugger and Welser banks of Augsburg, which is why Maximilian's army went unpaid for so long and why the mercenaries mutinied twice around 1509.
cause:
導火線是威尼斯在羅馬尼亞的擴張。十五世紀末到十六世紀初，威尼斯已控制亞得里亞海東岸的大片領土，又把拉文納、切爾維亞、法恩扎、里米尼等教宗的城市收進版圖，教皇國在羅馬尼亞方向的門戶洞開；一五〇六年威尼斯奪取博洛尼亞，教宗隨即宣布對威尼斯共和國絕罰，衝突從領土爭端升級為教會與國家的決裂。朱利奧二世更大的目標並非只是收復失地，而是拆散威尼斯對亞得里亞商業的壟斷、恢復教會在整個義大利的權威。
同盟之所以拉上法國與皇帝，是因為義大利沒有任何單一國家能單獨對抗威尼斯：法國需要米蘭，也覬覦威尼斯的鹽權與內陸市場，帝國需要收回波河下游的帝國城市與港口，費拉拉要保住費拉拉與科摩湖一帶的領土，佛羅倫斯要向威尼斯雪恥，於是各懷算盤走到一起，卻始終沒有就戰後的瓜分與邊界達成一致。
直接原因還有條約層面的破裂：威尼斯與教廷早年的和解條件到期，教宗不再承認威尼斯的既得權力；而威尼斯一旦察覺教廷要動手，先發制人的反而是它自己——一五〇八年九月，威尼斯先與巴耶齊德二世簽訂密約，把奧斯曼的錢與兵船拉進這場歐洲戰爭，聯盟的計畫因此在開戰之前就已被對方看穿。
causeEn: The trigger was Venetian expansion in the Romagna. By the end of the fifteenth and the opening of the sixteenth century Venice already held a great stretch of the eastern Adriatic coast and had drawn Ravenna, Cervia, Faenza and Rimini into its own territory, leaving the Papal States wide open on the Romagna side; when Venice seized Bologna in 1506 the pope answered with the excommunication of the Republic, and a dispute over territory became a rupture between a church and a state. Julius II's larger object was not merely to recover lost ground but to break Venice's commercial monopoly of the Adriatic and to restore the authority of the church over Italy as a whole. The League drew in France and the emperor because no single Italian state could face Venice alone: France wanted Milan and coveted Venetian salt and inland markets, the empire wanted its cities and ports back on the Po, Ferrara wanted to keep Ferrara and the lands around Lake Como, and Florence wanted to take its revenge, so all came together out of private calculation, though they never agreed on anything beyond the campaign itself. The immediate cause lay in the lapse of the treaty arrangements: the terms of reconciliation between Venice and the papacy had run out and the pope no longer recognised Venetian acquisitions; and once Venice grasped that the papacy meant to move, it struck first itself. In September 1508 it concluded its secret agreement with Bayezid II, drawing Ottoman money and Ottoman shipping into a European war, so that the League's plan was read by the other side before the fighting ever began.
impact:
這場戰爭的直接結果是威尼斯大陸擴張的終結。教宗收回羅馬尼亞的切爾維亞、法恩扎、里米尼與福爾利，威尼斯退守亞得里亞海與潟湖，費拉拉保住科摩湖一帶，帝國也取得維琴察與特雷維索等城市。威尼斯的主權中樞退回海上，國策從義大利大陸轉向地中海與東方航線，國力反而得以延續。
第二，聯盟把法國逐出義大利的嘗試，讓哈布斯堡的義大利政策成形。西班牙的費爾南多二世及其孫卡洛斯一世（後來的皇帝卡爾五世）藉此在義大利取得地盤，一五一一年以後的「神聖同盟」把目標從反威尼斯改為驅法，一五一三年與一五一六年的和約只是把法國勢力暫時擋在阿爾卑斯山另一側；從此到一五二五年的帕維亞，義大利戰場的主軸就是哈布斯堡與瓦洛瓦的對抗，而卡爾五世後來正是靠義大利的收益去支撐對法戰爭。
第三，技術與財政層面，這是一場「火砲決定會戰」的戰爭：阿涅德洛的野戰砲兵、圍帕多瓦的重砲，都顯示配給與供應比個人武藝更能左右會戰；而聯盟在金錢上的崩潰——馬西米利安的軍隊長期欠餉、瑞士傭兵在拉文納之後按兵不動——成為十六世紀僱傭兵軍隊惡性膨脹的先例，並直接預告了一五二七年羅馬被洗劫的亂局。
第四，威尼斯引奧斯曼的錢與兵船下場，是歐洲列強第一次把奧斯曼援助當作外交與戰爭的常規手段，其後在一五三八年、一五六八年與一五七一年的對奧同盟中一再出現，開啟了近代歐洲「以錢換兵」的聯盟模式。最後，這一輪消耗並沒有讓任何一方獲得決定性的安全：威尼斯保住本土卻失去帝國，米蘭與羅馬尼亞回到教宗與帝國的分割局面，而真正在下一個十年裡改寫歐洲的，是從這場聯盟裡長出來的哈布斯堡義大利體系。
impactEn: The immediate result of the war was the end of Venetian continental expansion. The pope recovered Cervia, Faenza, Rimini and Forli in the Romagna, Venice withdrew to the Adriatic and its lagoon, Ferrara kept the lands around Lake Como, and the empire took cities such as Vicenza and Treviso. The centre of Venetian sovereignty moved back to the sea, and the state's policy turned from the Italian mainland to the Mediterranean and the eastern trades, which is precisely why the Republic's strength survived. Second, the attempt to drive France out of Italy shaped Habsburg policy there. Ferdinand II of Aragon and his grandson Charles I, the future Emperor Charles V, used the League to gain a footing in Italy, and the Holy League of 1511 turned the object from resisting Venice to expelling the French; the peace of 1513 and the treaty of 1516 did nothing more than hold the French on the far side of the Alps for a time. From then until Pavia in 1525 the Italian theatre turned on the Habsburg-Valois contest, and Charles V would later pay for his war against France out of the revenues of Italy. Third, in technology and in finance this was a war decided by artillery: the field guns at Agnadello and the heavy guns used against Padua both showed that supply and distribution of ammunition told more in a battle than individual valour. The financial collapse of the League, with Maximilian's army going unpaid for long stretches and the Swiss mercenaries refusing to move after Ravenna, became a precedent for the way paid armies misbehaved in the sixteenth century and directly foreshadowed the disorder of the Sack of Rome in 1527. Fourth, bringing Ottoman money and Ottoman shipping into a European war was the first time the great powers of Europe treated Ottoman aid as an ordinary instrument of diplomacy and war; it reappeared in the alliances against the Ottomans of 1538, 1568 and 1571 and opened the modern European pattern of buying an ally with money. Last, the round of consumption left no one with decisive security: Venice kept its homeland but lost the empire, Milan and the Romagna fell back into the partition between the papacy and the empire, and the Habsburg Italian system that grew out of this League was the thing that would reshape Europe in the following decade.
result:
一五〇八年十二月十日同盟在康布雷成立，一五〇九年的戰役以阿涅德洛的大勝開場：威尼斯的陸軍幾乎全軍覆沒，帕多瓦、維琴察與特雷維索落入聯軍之手，聯軍的封鎖一度讓威尼斯在潟湖內外完全停頓。
一五〇九年聯盟的攻勢走到極限：圍帕多瓦不下，海上封鎖因艦隊折損而失效，帝國軍因欠餉與疫病散去；威尼斯的使節則在同年秋回到羅馬尼亞，開始利用法國與教宗之間的分歧。
一五一〇年教宗把法國逐出同盟，聯盟瓦解；一五一一年良十世另組「神聖同盟」，一五一二年的二月二十三日拉文納之役法軍獲勝、加斯東·德·福瓦陣亡，但六月瑞士傭兵拒戰使法軍退出羅馬尼亞，一五一三年法國與聯盟在奧爾維耶托議和。
一五一四年前後威尼斯再度取得拉文納的控制權；一五一六年努瓦松條約與一五一七年聖日耳曼昂萊和約把法國與威尼斯的關係拉回常態；一五一七年九月六日特雷比亞（洛迪）之戰，威尼斯軍在洛迪擊敗教皇與皇帝的聯軍；一五一八年康布雷休戰五年，戰爭以威尼斯保住本土與亞得里亞海、米蘭與羅馬尼亞回到教宗與帝國的分割局面告終。
resultEn: The League was proclaimed at Cambrai on 10 December 1508, and the campaign of 1509 opened with the great victory at Agnadello: the Venetian land army was very nearly wiped out, Padua, Vicenza and Treviso passed to the League, and the blockade once brought Venice in the lagoon almost to a complete standstill. In 1509 the offensive reached its limit: Padua would not fall, the blockade failed as the fleet was broken up, and the imperial army dissolved through unpaid wages and sickness, while the Venetian envoys returned to the Romagna in the autumn of that year and began to work on the disagreements between France and the papacy. In 1510 the pope expelled France and the League fell apart; Leo X formed the Holy League in 1511, and at Ravenna on 23 February 1512 the French won and Gaston de Foix was killed, but when the Swiss mercenaries stood fast in June the French were forced out of the Romagna, and in 1513 France and the League made peace at Orvieto. Venice recovered control of Ravenna around 1514; the Treaty of Noyon of 1516 and the peace of Saint-Germain-en-Laye of 1517 returned relations between France and Venice to their normal shape; on 6 September 1517 the Venetians beat the papal and imperial army at the Trebbia, at Lodi; and the truce of Cambrai of 1518, five years long, ended the war, leaving Venice with its homeland and the Adriatic, and Milan and the Romagna divided back between the papacy and the empire.
